title: Eduard Valmaseda Castellón
html:
Prof Eduard Valmaseda Castellón is Director del Departament d’Odontoestomatologia University of Barcelona, Spain, Director del Màster de Cirurgia Bucal i Implantologia Bucofacial,
Ex-president de la Sociedad Española de Cirugía Bucal (SECIB). He holds a DDS, PhD. is a full professor and Director of the Department of Dentistry (University of Barcelona). Leader of the group "Oral and Maxillofacial Pathology and Therapeutics" of the IDIBELL Research Institute. Ex-president of the Spanish Society of Oral Surgery (SECIB). Educard is a currengt serving member of the ADEE Board
